# dsh-study-note
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns explicitly opted-in conversations into structured Markdown stud
y notes. Each conversation starts with recording off; enabling one conversation does not enable anot
tes. Each conversation starts with recording off; enabling one conversation does not enable another.
## Quick start — tutorial
Requires Node.js 22.19+ and a DSH profile providing `commands`, `sessions`, and `llm`. Loader compos
ition is tested against DSH 0.1.0-rc.8, 0.1.1-rc.2, and 0.2.0-rc.2. The package contains executable
JavaScript and needs no install-time build.
1. Clone the plugin, install development dependencies, and create an installable archive:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
2. Install into your intended profile. This changes that profile; replace `desktop` if yours has ano
ther name. This package is not published to npm, so installing by npm name will not work.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
3. Restart that DSH profile if it has not hot-loaded the plugin. In a conversation, run the commands
below as separate messages, then ask a learning question and let the assistant finish its answer:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
4. Recording runs in the background after a complete answer. `/note sync` checks all completed eligi
ble turns immediately and retries pending failures; `/note status` reports the file and latest error
. Verify the generated document and root index in the configured notes directory. Disable this conve
rsation with `/note off`.
Uninstalling preserves notes and local state:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Conversation controls — reference
| Command | Behavior |
| `/note on [topic]` | Enable this conversation; process only complete turns that begin after enabli

ng. Repeating it does not reset the checkpoint. |
| `/note off` | Cancel and await background work,

retain existing files. After success no new automatic writes occur for this conversation. |
| `/note

status` | Show switch, directory, topic, file, pending work, and latest error. |
| `/note sync` | P

rocess eligible completed turns now; requires recording on. Does not backfill the off interval. |
|
`/note topic <topic>` | Pin a topic and move this conversation's existing note; rebuild the index. |
| `/note reindex` | Rebuild the plugin-owned root index, without a model call; also available while

off. |
| `/note new` | Clear the association only after the old note is deleted or moved outside th
e root; leaves recording off. Use `on` for a fresh start without historical backfill. |
Topics contain 1–64 letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a le
tter or digit. A pinned topic can create a directory; automatic topic selection only uses existing d
irectories, falling back to `inbox`. Subagent conversations cannot opt in.
## Notes and index — reference
[代码示例省略，未执行]
One document belongs to one conversation. A relevant question creates a section containing the quest
ion, one-line conclusion, explanation, formula/code/example, an AI-drafted understanding for you to
rewrite, unresolved questions, and source turn/event numbers. Follow-ups can update an existing sect
ion; unrelated questions add sections. Notes do not certify correctness or mastery.
Hand-edited sections are not replaced: related follow-ups append a supplemental section instead. Pre
serve the HTML metadata and section markers. Renames and moves within the root are discovered on the
next write or `/note reindex`; external edits are not watched continuously. Deleting a note does no
t silently recreate it. Keep one copy per conversation inside the root.
Only the region between `` and `` is maintained in `README.md`. Handwritten entries outside that reg
ion stay unchanged. Only this plugin's documents join its index; existing unrelated notes are not re
written or automatically cataloged.
## Configuration — reference
The bundle entry id is `study-note`. An optional overlay selects a different root:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Save the overlay at a path you choose and pass `--patch <absolute-overlay-path>` when launching the
profile. Alternatively merge the entry into your profile patch, preserving other entries. This proje
ct does not change your active profile or existing knowledge base.
| Field | Default | Meaning |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy, cost, and failures — reference
Never-enabled conversations produce no recording files or auxiliary model calls. Recording selects h
uman-origin text and the last complete assistant text from future completed turns; it excludes reaso
ning blocks, tool results, images, injected user messages, and interrupted output. Exact routine ack
nowledgements and progress questions are filtered locally; other irrelevant turns may still require
a model call to decide to skip.
Each eligible turn can cause an additional paid request to the configured provider, including skippe
d content. Only one request runs at a time per conversation; different conversations may run concurr
ently. Prior note sections, including your edits in those sections, can enter these requests. The pl
ugin does not read API keys or ambient environment values, but does not redact secrets that you type
d into conversation text. Do not enable it for sensitive conversations unless that provider and loca
l retention are acceptable.
Before dispatch, the exact system prompt, messages, route, token limit, and source event numbers are
written to `.study-note/requests/`. These local audit files retain selected conversation text even
if the model skips the turn or recording is then disabled. New files use owner-only permissions; the
y are not encrypted and existing parent permissions are not tightened. Disabling or uninstalling doe
s not erase files; there is no automatic retention cleanup.
The auxiliary request is not inserted into the main model history or DSH session log. The tested hos
t cannot safely register external informational session events, so replay requires keeping the plugi
n audit directory alongside the DSH conversation log. No shell command or model tool executes during
ectory alongside the DSH conversation log. No shell command or model tool executes during recording.
[该节后续省略]
